To mitigate the field-of-view mismatch in dual-camera imaging, we propose an image registration method based on synchronous and asynchronous image acquisitions. …

By applying optimized post-processing techniques, we demonstrate image reconstruction of microscopic features under photon-limited conditions using a limited number of illumination patterns. …

This study compares CBCT and nCLE for sampling tool position in navigation bronchoscopy for peripheral pulmonary nodules (PPNs). Twenty-five patients with PPNs scheduled for CBCT-guided navigation bronchoscopy were prospectively enrolled. …

articles.summary: High‐dimensional (HD) entanglement of photonic spatial modes endows photon pair with greater shared information, enabling secure quantum communication even in noisy environments. However, adequately characterizing HD spatial mode entanglement remains challenging due to the exponential scaling of measurements and data processing complexity. Here, we develop and experimentally demonstrate a physics‐informed neural network for efficient quantum state tomography (QST) of HD spatial mode entanglement. Our method substantially reduces the number of coincidence counts required for QST and enables physics‐informed reconstruction from only two projective measurements. …
